checkpoints.description: [1/1] Verified: 11 implicit-state fixes plus docs/STATE_MACHINES.md and ADR-176; input gate 2/2, ring radius 2/2, restore weapon 10/10, hazard disarm 80/80; 456 vitest (81 files), 365 mechanics (53 files), typecheck/lint/build clean, 8/8 AIKit; checklists: passed

[1/1] Improve story feedback, mob fairness and fight/UI state: preserve core-memory rewards and toast completion, add a stagger guard against stun-lock, emit every crossed boss phase, align banner timing and guard stale choice cards

impact_assessment.why: The state-machine audit deferred these as safe, evidence-backed follow-ups; core memory rewards are dropped at the data boundary, every hit staggers non-bosses, a double boss phase jump emits one cue, and the banner timing is split.
impact_assessment.benefits: Story completion is felt in-run, casters cannot be permanently stun-locked, phase jumps announce each phase, and UI timers/choice cards stop disagreeing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: content mapping, enemy field/transition, boss phase return type, Hud default, App choice guard; dependency: none; concurrency: content/enemies/world/Hud/App; state: no save schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure content test, stagger and boss-phase sim tests, full npm test/mechanics, typecheck/lint/build, AIKit 8/8 and strict delivery.

impact_assessment.why: All six rooms share one furniture set, and three residents walk through furniture.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: sprite_atlas.json props gains six keys; dependency: the main generator rebuilds the atlas, so new props must be in its list; concurrency: none; state: no save data changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Props added to the generator's own list and palette; atlas round-trip verified byte-identical; tests require each prop in the atlas and in its room, on floor, off routes.
